reply.summary: Tauco is an exiled enchantress who keeps a crooked hut on a storm-battered rock and raises a stolen foundling with fierce, unorthodox tenderness. Her spells bind serpents and bend the tide, though she distrusts every deity above her.

feats.scene: Tauco calls up a hex-driven gale that rips the roof off a coastal fortress in a single night.
Tauco shrugs off a falling cliff-slab that she warded only at the last moment.

reply.summary: Eoleoill is a flamboyant sorceress who runs a villains' academy from a shadowed hall, handing out dangerous errands to apprentices. She reshapes bodies at a glance and drifts above the floor while lecturing.

feats.scene: Eoleoill twists a charging war-beast into a flock of squealing swine with one flick of her wrist.
Eoleoill walks unscratched through a collapsing arcade of stone pillars.

reply.summary: Teltiva is a half-divine sorceress who dreams of a throne and recruits a brigade of resentful men to take it. Her spellwork only flows when both palms are free, so she fights with arms spread wide.

feats.scene: Teltiva hurls a lance of raw force that cracks a stone bridge in half.
Teltiva survives a point-blank tank shell with only a ringing in her ears.

reply.summary: Ranin is a centuries-old enchantress who stays youthful by drinking a brew steeped from rare roots. She turns men into beasts that match their hearts and lives in dread of an oracle's warning.

feats.scene: Ranin turns a whole boarding party into snarling wolves before they reach her gangplank.
Ranin walks away from a crumbling terrace without a bruise, kept spry by her potion.

reply.summary: Neaminil is a desert witch cursed with endless life by a spurned suitor, slowly watching her beauty wither. Bitter, she learned the occult to turn men into animals of her choosing.

feats.scene: Neaminil changes a king's champion into a squealing boar that bolts for the nearest ravine.
Neaminil lives on after a fall from a high dune that would kill any ordinary traveller.

reply.summary: Sticareon is an ancient witch who senses hidden power at a glance and raised a half-alien son to topple a noble house. She blasts with sickly green force and has outlived her age.

feats.scene: Sticareon vaporises a block of derelict tenements with one eldritch bolt.
Sticareon stands in the heart of a collapsing tower and walks out unmarked.

reply.summary: Aurnu is a cartoon sorceress with a taste for mischief, swooping through the sky and transfiguring anyone who annoys her. She cackles when a spell lands.

feats.scene: Aurnu turns a bus-load of tourists into ducks and herds them across the highway.
Aurnu bounces off a collapsing billboard and keeps cackling.

reply.summary: Soriumres runs a cramped ink parlour, inking charms that grant odd effects to whoever wears them. She punishes cruelty by turning offenders into small animals, then learns shame when she looks inside a stranger's heart.

feats.scene: Soriumres changes a snarling bully into a whimpering puppy in the middle of a crowded cafe.
Soriumres takes a shove into a shelf of paint jars and gets up laughing.

reply.summary: Lleanu is a grey-haired undead drifter who skulks the rainy docks, hungry and unpredictable. She shuffles through alleys with a stiff gait and a nasty grin.

feats.scene: Lleanu hurls a rusted barrel across a loading bay to keep a patrolman away.
Lleanu keeps lurching after being clipped by a slow delivery van.

reply.summary: Cintelser is a media-savvy young archer in a parallel world of pampered heroes, loosing gadget-tipped shafts between photo shoots. She is more celebrity than soldier, yet her aim stays true.

feats.scene: Cintelser pins a fleeing thief's sleeve to a wall with a smoke-puffing bolt from fifty paces.
Cintelser tumbles down a flight of marble stairs and stands up with her hair still perfect.
Cintelser's arrow crosses the plaza in a blink before it strikes the target.

reply.summary: Esita is a cheerful teen at an academy for young champions, an athletic archer who also trains hand-to-hand. She carries a quiver of novelty arrows and a cheeky catchphrase for every bullseye.

feats.scene: Esita launches a net-arrow that snares a runaway mascot on the sports field.
Esita lands a flip off the gym rafters and shrugs off the thud.

reply.summary: Covival is a masked patriot who fought briefly beside a band of wartime heroes before falling in battle. Little else is known about this anonymous fighter.

feats.scene: Covival swings a flagpole into a charging soldier's chest and drops him in the mud.
Covival keeps swinging after a rifle butt cracks across the mask.

reply.summary: Liuiu is a red-haired student turned bloodsucker who infected her friends in a feverish thirst. She is quick, tough and hard to kill, and was brought back after being slain.

feats.scene: Liuiu snaps the door off a campus van to get at the driver.
Liuiu climbs out of a smashed car with torn muscle already knitting.

reply.summary: Tautetes is a young crimefighter who traded years of her life for bursts of overwhelming power. After grief shaved her head, she kept patrolling a grim skyline with a wry mouth.

feats.scene: Tautetes slams a falling airliner's wing back onto its axis with a burst of borrowed might.
Tautetes stands unharmed beneath a collapsing bridge deck.
Tautetes crosses a ruined avenue faster than the echo of her own shout.

reply.summary: Resaurn is a runaway teen whose hands burst into flame when she is angry. She steals to survive and turns on the officials who once caged her.

feats.scene: Resaurn sets a parked fuel truck ablaze with a snap of her fingers and scatters the guards.
Resaurn leaps from a burning rooftop with no more than singed shoelaces.

reply.summary: Sisoniu is a flame-wielding criminal who headed a crew of disaster-themed thugs in a river city. She torches her enemies in bursts and gloats over the smoke.

feats.scene: Sisoniu engulfs a derelict warehouse in a rolling fireball that lights the harbor.
Sisoniu strolls out of a burning stairwell without a blister.

reply.summary: Tumti is a talking shellfish in a buccaneer's hat who steals a rain-bending machine and drowns a coastal metropolis to rob its submerged shops. His crew of goons fumble most plans.

feats.scene: Tumti triggers his stolen device and sends a wall of seawater over the waterfront skyline.
Tumti keeps scowling after a bank door flattens his shell against a wall.

reply.summary: Raure is a veteran police chief of a dark metropolis who keeps a red telephone on his desk for calling a masked ally. He is loyal, trusting and rarely credited.

feats.scene: Raure shoulders a locked office door off its hinges to reach a trapped clerk.
Raure rides out a nightstick blow to the ribs and keeps issuing orders.

reply.summary: Nilnullu is a career beat officer who rises through a parallel city's ranks to become its top lawman. He stays calm through the strangest crises and calls in help when criminals gain strange powers.

feats.scene: Nilnullu tackles a fleeing mugger and pins him against a lamp post.
Nilnullu absorbs a flung trash can and keeps his whistle in his teeth.

reply.summary: Sente is a hard-working, loyal police chief who stays at his commissioner's shoulder through puzzle-laden crimes. A happily married man, he meets a grim end at the hands of a masked killer.

feats.scene: Sente cracks a heavy case file against a suspect's desk to demand a confession.
Sente takes a scuffle in the evidence room and straightens his collar.

reply.summary: Tilan is a sharp-eyed newspaper reporter who exists only as a prank of a mischievous imp from another dimension. She vanishes the moment his spell is undone.

feats.scene: Tilan slaps a tabloid down on a desk hard enough to rattle a coffee cup.
Tilan stays upright when a crowd jostles her at a press conference.

reply.summary: Telul is the adopted son of city founders in a class-divided alternate world, raised among the wealthy until he recalls his stellar origin. He dons a gleaming costume and fights for the toiling masses.

feats.scene: Telul rips a factory gate from its hinges and hurls it across the yard.
Telul stands his ground as a mob of guards open fire with cannons.

reply.summary: Stole is a drifting former bank robber who left his family to keep them safe, served time, and returned hoping to meet his estranged son. He is regretful, gruff and under someone else's control for a spell.

feats.scene: Stole shoves a vault trolley through a bank lobby during an old heist.
Stole takes a baton to the shoulder and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Astiu is a thick-necked hoodlum with an unnatural body, strong enough to bend steel and tough enough to ignore pistol fire. He enjoys breaking safes with bare hands.

feats.scene: Astiu bends a steel vault door outward with both fists.
Astiu laughs off a hail of pistol rounds on a loading dock.

reply.summary: Tiustce is a showy criminal who dresses like a jester and robs with a flourish in a world of comic-strip heroes. He relies on gags and goons rather than power.

feats.scene: Tiustce swings a cane through a shop window to start a robbery.
Tiustce lands on his back in an alley and bounces up grinning.

reply.summary: Sivaela is a bald scribe of comics who, after losing his job, was struck by a freak bolt and became a madly confident deity. He teleports objects at whim and fires blasts while trying to perfect the cosmos.

feats.scene: Sivaela flings a barrage of blasts that scours the surface of a small moon.
Sivaela keeps ranting while a battery of beams burns across his chest.

reply.summary: Numrnrum is a spidery carnival performer with four arms and quick fingers, equally gifted at sleight of hand and picking pockets. He tours with a travelling big-top troupe.

feats.scene: Numrnrum lifts three wallets and a pocket watch from one crowd in a single pass.
Numrnrum drops from the tent rigging into a hay bale and strolls off.

reply.summary: Eonmonco is a patient widow who once called the police on a stranger claiming to be her missing husband, then helped bring him home. She is steady, polite and slow to lose her temper.

feats.scene: Eonmonco hurls a ceramic teapot at a prowler in her kitchen.
Eonmonco stays on her feet after a stumble on a wet porch.

reply.summary: Lanrital is a stolen child raised by a glowing, godlike guardian and later by retired adventurers, who grows into a masked vigilante carrying an unearned legacy. He wrestles with the weight of inherited power.

feats.scene: Lanrital unmakes a hillside bunker in a flash of blue light.
Lanrital walks out of a collapsing apartment block without a mark.

reply.summary: Amocorna is a wartime cartoon champion from a faraway doomed planet, raised on a farmland orphanage's steps and working as a reporter by day. He leaps tall structures and sinks enemy ships.

feats.scene: Amocorna capsizes a line of warships by lifting their hulls from below.
Amocorna stands in a field of bombs and brushes dust from his sleeve.
Amocorna outpaces a rifle round across a river valley.

reply.summary: Leesi is a volunteer frozen for decades after a secret wartime experiment, thawed to join a team of mashup heroes. He flies, shoots heat from his eyes and has overwhelming strength.

feats.scene: Leesi shatters a bunker roof with a single overhead strike.
Leesi endures a barrage of shells and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Sesauton is a missing spaceman, rebuilt by cruel aliens into a living weapon, who rules a mirror world as a tyrant beside his powerful wife. He answers to no one and sneers at pleas.

feats.scene: Sesauton blasts a mountain range into glowing slag with a point-blank wave.
Sesauton laughs while a battery of orbital cannons pounds his chest.

reply.summary: Amcesso is a gunman raised by decent foster parents without knowing his criminal blood, steered by an implant in his skull toward theft. He gets a taste of fame before things collapse.

feats.scene: Amcesso shoots out a security camera and vaults a teller's counter.
Amcesso takes a blow from a rifle stock and keeps robbing.

reply.summary: Rnvine is a towering, bronze-skinned scientist and adventurer who trained for years before facing the world and keeps a lab fortress. He leads a team of friends and investigates a mystery about his father's grave.

feats.scene: Rnvine lands a right hook that drops a brawny smuggler across a crate.
Rnvine climbs out of a collapsed crypt shaft coated in grave dirt.

reply.summary: Naialse is a power-less grandson of a famed hero, raised by a masked patriarch to fight crime as a winged partner. He takes his own identity out of respect for bloodlines and tackles robotic menaces.

feats.scene: Naialse topples a hulking robot by cutting its leg cables with a grapnel.
Naialse endures a hard fall from a rooftop and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Estana is a protective older sister who tries to hide the truth when her sibling transforms into an insect-like creature. She lies to reporters, then confesses to officials.

feats.scene: Estana swings a lamp at a snooping intruder in her family's living room.
Estana stays calm through a grilling by stern agents in a windowless room.

reply.summary: Taiunti is an ordinary red-haired woman whose mind holds a shard of a terrible universal formula, hunted by a tyrant for it. A warrior from the skies carries her to safety.

feats.scene: Taiunti shoves a guard off balance during an escape across a bridge.
Taiunti keeps running after a stumble on gravel.

reply.summary: Anrnunan is a gambler's youngest brother and mob enforcer who adopts a mask, hoping to look fearsome, and loses his hands to a rival blade. He wears a nickname nobody remembers.

feats.scene: Anrnunan smashes a bookmaker's till with a swing of a mallet.
Anrnunan stays upright after a crowbar blow to the shoulder.

reply.summary: Taltasan is a pointy-eared wanderer of a snowy north, cursed to give away everything he owns. He envies the cave of a famed wizard and is turned away without a word of pity.

feats.scene: Taltasan drags a heavy sledge of gifts up an icy ridge.
Taltasan trudges through a blizzard for days without frostbite.

reply.summary: Tiaanu is a gang thug from a far-future age who joined a band of villains and a mob crew, always demanding fair pay before a fight. He is lazy, greedy and loud.

feats.scene: Tiaanu hurls a cargo crate at a pursuing guard on a transit platform.
Tiaanu shrugs off a stun-baton jab and complains about wages.

reply.summary: Sevalcar is a one-handed schemer who kidnaps industrial leaders by hijacking trains and replaces them with trained doubles. He ends up hauled off after a speedy chase through a factory.

feats.scene: Sevalcar swings a steel hook at a pursuer from a moving railcar.
Sevalcar stumbles from a derailed carriage and keeps barking orders.

reply.summary: Temine is a mechanical sea-monster disguised in a harbor as part of a trio of fake giants, easy to unmask and easy to arrest. It bobs in the water, clanking.

feats.scene: Temine lashes a metal pincer across a fishing pier and splinters the planks.
Temine bobs back up after a freighter's bow glances off its plating.

reply.summary: Rninansan is a clanking sea-creature automaton, one of three decoys bobbing in the surf to lure undersea heroes. It snaps its pincers at passing boats.

feats.scene: Rninansan snaps a rowboat in two with a single pincer clamp.
Rninansan takes a trawler's prow to the casing and keeps clacking.

reply.summary: Iusecin is a masked hooligan who appears once to menace a team of oddball heroes. He prowls rooftops and scuttles off at dawn.

feats.scene: Iusecin swipes a gloved fist through a skylight and shatters it.
Iusecin drops from a gutter onto gravel and sprints away.

reply.summary: Nusrilor is a white-eyed lab-grown brute who leads a tribe of sewer outcasts in an uprising against the surface. His mind is a fortress, shrugging off psychic attacks and shattering barriers.

feats.scene: Nusrilor breaks a force bubble with a surge of fury and caves in a tunnel mouth.
Nusrilor stands in a barrage of stolen rifle fire and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Catoriar is a speed-obsessed racecar driver, calm under pressure and rooted like stone, who joined the second squad of daring explorers. He trusts engines more than people.

feats.scene: Catoriar rams a roadblock with a stripped-down dragster and clears the barrier.
Catoriar walks away from a flipped car on a banked curve.
Catoriar hits top speed down a salt flat in a modified racer.

reply.summary: Ollelaro is a private eye who dresses as a rubber-nosed clown to flip the underworld on its head, using gags and gadgets to befuddle thugs. He guards a crime-ridden riverside town alone.

feats.scene: Ollelaro lands a two-fisted flurry on a mummy-wrapped crook beside a sarcophagus.
Ollelaro escapes a sealed stone coffin with a prepared solvent.

reply.summary: Seseo is a bald, yellow-eyed mass of living mud who can mimic any person and stretch into wings or towers. A mind-controlling trickster uses him as a disguise until his true identity is exposed.

feats.scene: Seseo swells to the height of a house and flattens a parked van with one slam.
Seseo reforms his torso after a gunfight blows a hole through it.

reply.summary: Cotival is a bald, yellow-eyed shape of living clay who fights in a future city where most powers have been switched off. He swells to great size and swats opponents aside.

feats.scene: Cotival balloons to the height of a lamppost and smashes a barricade of cars.
Cotival absorbs a hail of bullets into his soft body and reforms.

reply.summary: Tilcol is a sentient scrap of mud that woke up on its own after being parted from its parent for a long time. Childlike and loyal, it befriends a weary lawman and answers to a nickname.

feats.scene: Tilcol slaps a mugger with an oversized mud fist and sends him sprawling.
Tilcol squelches back together after being stomped flat in an alley.
